prompt:
Theme:
Glasses reflecting night light

Subject:
A vertical bust-up shot with a single woman in the center against a night city background. Holding thin metal frame glasses with the right hand, the left and right lenses clearly reflect white and orange urban lights.

Person/Expression:
The face is almost front-on, with a quiet expression and large gray-brown almond-shaped eyes looking straight ahead. A smooth oval contour and small round chin, thin bridge of the nose, and glossy nude pink lips with a thin upper lip and thick lower lip. Thin parallel eyebrows, delicate eyeliner tightening the outer corners of the eyes, pale orange lower eyelids, and glowing skin. Dark brown hair has thin clumped bangs down, is loosely tied in the back, and thin loose strands fall around the face.

Clothing/Pose:
Thin white shoulder straps and a deep V-neck sheer white camisole top, a thin silver necklace, and a dangling openwork ornament on the left ear. The person's left shoulder is slightly forward, and the person's left hand (right side of the screen) lightly holds the temple of the glasses.

Background/Light:
The dark navy night scene melts into large bluish-white bokeh and a small amount of orange light. A cold rim light from the top right and a soft warm light from the bottom front create a smooth glow on the cheeks and collarbone.

Composition/Camera:
A 3:4 vertical close-up portrait cropping from the chest to the top of the head. The face is in the center of the top half, focus is on the glasses and eyes, and the chest is cut off at the bottom edge. At approximately eye level, the background is strongly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Fine photorealistic real photo. Depicts the reflection of the glasses, metal, sheer fabric, and skin humidity in high resolution, adjusted to cinematic blue and orange night tones.

Negative:
Significant change in facial features; omission of glasses reflection.
